verdict.rationale: Messaging surfaces are a fair question for a self-hosted AI chat assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes LibreChat as a self-hosted web app with one unified interface. Nothing shows a WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage integration or bot surface.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
